description:
The authenticated principal, as this knowledge base names it.

The `did` is the identity: it is what the bus stamps on every event, what resource creation is attributed to, and what a client must compare against to recognise its own work in the data. It is the only identifier: a row id would appear nowhere else in the system and correlate with nothing.

The remaining fields exist to be displayed, and all of them come from the token's own claims.

did.description: The authenticated principal's DID: `did:web:<domain>:agents:<subject>` for an agent, whose token's `kind` claim is `agent`, and `did:web:<domain>:users:<subject>` for a person, where the subject is the issuer claim the knowledge base names its principals by (`identity.subjectClaim`).

email.description: The address the token carries, when it carries one: an agent's account need not have one.

domain.description: The knowledge base's domain: the authority the principal is named under.
